facts.fact: NITDA, through the Office for Nigerian Digital Innovation and convened by the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, held a technical validation workshop in Lagos with more than 60 hub operators, startup founders and investors on the draft National Innovation Hubs Standard Framework, weeks after a stakeholders' engagement in Abuja; ThisDay reported it on 2026-09-07, which is used as the date because the document says only 'recently'.
